(Japanese: '''すべてのナゾを解き明かせ！ポケットモンスターXY&Z完全マスタースペシャル！！''' ''Uncover All the Mysteries! The {{tt|Pocket Monsters|Pokémon}} XY&Z Complete Overview Special!!'') is a two-hour [[List of animated series specials|animated series special]] that aired in Japan on December 31, 2015.

The first one-hour part consisted of ''[[XYS04|Pokémon: Mega Evolution Special IV'']] and [[XY094|''From A to Z!]]''. The second one-hour part consist of looking back at past adventures, attempting to understand the mysteries. It also looks at upcoming developments.
